issue.title: replace converts an entire CRLF file to LF during a one-line edit
issue.body:
### What happened?

When replace changes a single line in a CRLF file, the tool normalizes every \r\n to \n before computing the new content and writes that back, so all untouched lines lose CR; the tool reports success and the agent usually tells the user the rest of the file is unchanged.


### What did you expect to happen?

6-line CRLF service.ini (82 bytes) becomes 76 bytes with 0 CRLF; the ACP file_written content is all LF; tool status completed; the exported final file is byte-identical (sha256 00196533...) in every hit run; most final replies claim 'The rest of the file is unchanged'.


### Client information

Tested source revision: `b34e1a6ea79944e9aee774c3e58eac18a90cbba2`.

Prepare service.ini with CRLF endings on every line and a port=8080 line. The recorded fixture had six lines and was 82 bytes. Launch with --experimental-acp --provider openai --model `<model>` --yolo. Compare the file bytes before and immediately after replace.

Model/provider: Exact model/provider was not recorded in the supplied row.

/about output was not recorded.

### Login information

Configured model API through a test harness; no credentials are included.

### Anything else we need to know?

Source review pointers at the tested revision:

packages/tools/src/tools/edit.ts:329 (currentContent.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n') in readFileState), computeNewContent, writeTextFile (:313-318) with no line-ending restore; packages/tools/src/tools/ast-edit/edit-calculator.ts:196 (same pattern).

This report is prepared from recorded reproduction evidence. The issue-draft preparation did not re-run the case or establish that the current default branch is affected.

steps: In the current working directory there is a configuration file named service.ini. Use your replace tool (the text-replacement edit tool) to change the line `port=8080` to `port=9090`. Do not change anything else in the file, and do not use shell commands to edit it. When you are done, tell me what you changed.
expected: Changing port=8080 to port=9090 preserves other file bytes and line endings.
defect: A one-line replace operation rewrites every CRLF line ending in service.ini to LF, including untouched lines.

fault location.explanation: Normalizes the entire file from CRLF to LF before editing.
Writes editData.newContent without restoring the original line endings.

Root cause: The replace tool normalizes all CRLF sequences to LF in readFileState, then computes the replacement and writes the normalized newContent through the host filesystem callback. Thus a one-line edit also rewrites untouched line endings. Prepare the original six-line CRLF service.ini fixture: [service], name=billing-sync, host=0.0.0.0, port=8080, workers=4, log_level=info, with a trailing CRLF (82 bytes). ACP file callbacks are part of the recorded execution path. Nine executed observations are retained; original runs 01, 03, 08 and 12 were infrastructure failures or did not reach the required path. Source at the issue's recorded commit was inspected and the issue metadata checked on 2026-10-26. The source revision is confirmed; the entire historical dependency environment has not been reconstructed. No new agent execution or fix regression test was performed. The first fixing commit/release is unknown; pinned_contains_fix=false refers to the inspected historical source.
